chapter: Donaldsonville, family and Richard M. Jones
title: Donaldsonville pianists and Monnie Jones's mother
summary: Pianists of Donaldsonville, Fishing Braid and Si Cal, Monnie's mother in the St. Patrick Street district, and pictures of Monnie.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Yeah, I know. I ain't gonna tell nobody. Was that it? Do you remember? Yeah, yeah, yeah. That was a good number. Yeah. There were a lot of good tunes. Did you ever know a piano player from Donaldsonville called Fishing Braid? Nope. His right name was Richard Barrett. I think...

I heard of Tony Cal or something like that. Cy Cal. You ever heard of Cy Cal or something? Tell me he's holding me. He got... Mm-mm. The only piano player that I knew around Donaldsonville was Monnie Jones and Claiborne William Darden. We call her Bella. Bella. Mm-hmm. I just wanted because...

What you call that name for me again? Fishing Braid they called him. But... His name was Richard Barrett. He must have been older than Monnie, you see. Because I think he helped Monnie if I remember it right. See, I looked at Monnie's story and I thought maybe you'd know some of the same people and could straighten us out on them.
You got this... Monnie's mother was near Mary Hall. You got that?
You told me that once. Y'all did tell you that? You told me about her. Mm-hmm.
Do you have any pictures of Monnie? No, Monnie had it somewhere around there, but I don't know a lot of things got away. My mother.

Where was Cemetery Street? Didn't they have a Cemetery Street or something in Donaldsonville? St. Patrick Street. Oh. Is that the one by the cemetery? Yeah. Oh. Was the cemetery pretty... I mean that St. Patrick Street was a pretty wide open area and that? It was a district. It was a district. They had a...

In that district. Yeah. That's what... that's what uh... Monnie's mother was. Mm-hmm. She was... when I met her, she was in the district. Up there? Yeah, correct. We call that Tenderlion Street. Oh, Tenderlion. We call it Tenderlion. I'm direct from there. You get the fruit of it. We call it Tenderlion Street. She called me in the house and introduced me to her after she found that out what my name was. Mm-hmm. Told me that she was... Monnie's mother. She was a fine little woman.

Well, you don't remember Richard... Did... Does he have any family up there in uh... Donaldsonville there? Sure. A lot of them up there. Oh, my aunts and everything. Did they have any pictures of him when he was young? Which name got all the pictures? Lionel or...
Uh... I'm quite sure he got some. Uh... Let me get that book. Dick. Let me see if... Okay, we can start. Here we go.
Alright, let's see. We're talking about Richard L. Jones and the Lionel. Now, uh... And any more about Richard that you know? I guess we've covered about everything you know about him.
Yeah, you can go on the farm if you want.
